I read the structure region by region and assembled the SMILES below.

**Left part.** A pyrazolo[1,5-a][1,5]benzodiazepine core. The pyrazole carries a carboxamide (C(N)=O) at C3 and a 4-phenoxyphenyl group at C2. The pyrazole N1 is bonded to a CH2CH2 chain that leads to the benzo ring. The other pyrazole carbon is bonded to an NH, which is bonded to the benzo ring. The benzo ring carries the C(=O) group that links to the piperidine nitrogen.

SMILES of the core: NC(=O)c1c(-c2ccc(Oc3ccccc3)cc2)nn2c1Nc1ccc(cc1CC2)C(=O)N...

**Linker.** The piperidine is substituted at C4 with a CH2 that connects to a piperazine nitrogen. The other piperazine nitrogen is attached to the isoindoline-dione aryl ring.

**Right part.** The isoindoline-1,3-dione ring has fluorine at position 5 and the piperazine at position 6. In the drawing, the aryl carbon bearing F is adjacent to the carbon bearing the piperazine. The imide nitrogen is attached to the 2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl group.

The aryl ring runs: C3a (attached to the C=O at the top right), then CH, then C–F, then C–N(piperazine), then CH, then C7a (attached to the lower C=O).

SMILES of the aryl ring: c1(F)cc2C(=O)N(...)C(=O)c2cc1N

Full SMILES:

NC(=O)c1c(-c2ccc(Oc3ccccc3)cc2)nn2CCc3cc(ccc3Nc12)C(=O)N1CCC(CN2CCN(CC2)c2cc3C(=O)N(C4CCC(=O)NC4=O)C(=O)c3cc2F)CC1

I checked the aryl ring in this SMILES. The atom c2 bears the piperazine nitrogen, then c is a CH, then c3 is the ring-fusion carbon bonded to C(=O), which leads to the imide N and the other C(=O). That C(=O) attaches to c3, the second fusion carbon, followed by c (CH) and c2F (the F-bearing carbon, which closes the ring to the piperazine-bearing carbon). The F-bearing carbon is therefore adjacent to the piperazine-bearing carbon, as drawn.

The core fusion also checks out. In `nn2CCc3cc(ccc3Nc12)...`, the ring closure 1 is opened at c1 (the carboxamide-bearing carbon), and `c12` closes ring 1 and ring 2, so that carbon is bonded to the carboxamide carbon, the NH, and the pyrazole N. The ring closures are consistent.

SMILES: NC(=O)c1c(-c2ccc(Oc3ccccc3)cc2)nn2CCc3cc(ccc3Nc12)C(=O)N1CCC(CN2CCN(CC2)c2cc3C(=O)N(C4CCC(=O)NC4=O)C(=O)c3cc2F)CC1
